user.title: Vision
user.description:
Home Assistant will look after your devices: computers, phones and TVs. Once the integration is added, each device enrolls itself when you install its agent from the Vision dashboard.

Pick a starting point; each module can then be turned on or off in Configure → Modules.

cle.title: Enrollment key
cle.description:
{changee}Administrators only: the key is no longer shown anywhere else.

**Current key**: `{cle}`

New device enrollment: **{inscriptions}**.

**PC** — in PowerShell, on the PC to set up:
```
{commande}
```

**Phone, tablet, TV** — block to paste into the app:
```
{android}
```

Do not leave the command or the block on a supervised device. Changing the key does not affect devices that are already enrolled.

inscriptions.title: New device enrollment
inscriptions.description:
New device enrollment: **{etat}**.

“Allow for {minutes} min” opens enrollment and closes it again by itself, even if Home Assistant restarts in the meantime. For a device that is already enrolled (app reinstalled), use “Allow re-enrollment” on its page instead; QR pairing, approved by an administrator, does not need enrollment to be open.

qr.title: Create a pairing QR code
qr.description:
The device scans this QR code from the Vision app and pairs by itself. The QR code works only once and expires within a few minutes; it does not contain the enrollment key.

Person: choose now or later. Device: only to **take over** a device that is already enrolled (app reinstalled); otherwise an already enrolled device is refused.

qr_affiche.description:

In the Vision app on the device: **Scan the Home Assistant QR code**. Valid for {minutes} minutes, only once. Do not leave it where anyone can see it: it can enroll a device.

deverrouillage.title: Unlock requests
deverrouillage.description:
{demandes} Pick one, then approve it (shortening the time if you like) or decline it.

**Delivery**: “direct”, the device unlocks by itself; “code”, you read a 6-digit code to the person; “QR”, the person scans the screen.

ajouter_installer_pc.description:
{qui}

On the PC, open **PowerShell** (Windows key, type “PowerShell”, Enter), paste the command below and press Enter. Accept the administrator prompt.

data_description.personnes_affichage: The Home Assistant people created for a TV or a shared screen, not for anyone in particular. Empty: the one named “Affichage”.

accueil.title: Welcome messages
accueil.description:
{erreur}The message shown at the top of the app, on each device, in its language. Write one message per line; the variables below are filled in when the message is shown. Nothing written: “Hello!” (“Good evening!” from 6 pm).

“Depending on the time of day” mode: start a line with `morning:`, `afternoon:`, `evening:` or `night:` (or `matin:`, `apres-midi:`, `soir:`, `nuit:`) to keep it for that time (morning 5 am–12 pm, afternoon 12–6 pm, evening 6–10 pm, night 10 pm–5 am); a line without a prefix is used at any time. “Random” mode: prefixes are ignored.

For experts (Advanced section): a Home Assistant Jinja template replaces the messages, with the same variables, for example `{exemple}`. If it fails, or renders an empty text or more than 200 characters, the normal message is shown.

**Variables** (current value)
{aide}

**Preview** (what is saved)
{apercu}

avance.name: Advanced (for experts)

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: {erreur}Tick what you need: everything else disappears everywhere (Home Assistant, apps, TVs, PCs). Its settings are kept for later; its entities are disabled without losing their history. The core (devices, people and roles, remote management, updates) always stays on.

modules_protections.title: Turn off the protections?
modules_protections.description:
⚠️ Without the anti-bypass protections, a supervised person can uninstall Vision, become an administrator of their PC or open the protected settings, and so lift all the rules. {concernes}: {appareils}.

Only turn them off if you trust everyone who uses these devices.

data.je_comprends: I understand, turn off the protections

entites.title: Home Assistant entities
entites.description:
The Home Assistant widgets in the Vision app: each device only sees the entities given to its person (plus its exceptions) and can only use the actions ticked here. Read-only by default; locks and alarms can never be controlled from a device.

{resume}

entites_actions.title: Allowed actions
entites_actions.description: {pilotables} Tick what the devices may do (the role function “Control allowed entities” is also needed); nothing ticked = read-only. Locks and alarms are never offered.

error.cle_invalide: The key must be 12 to 64 characters, with no spaces, and must not be a published example.
error.code_inconnu: Unknown or expired code: start the request again on the device.
error.qr_impossible: Could not create the QR code (Home Assistant address unknown, or too many QR codes in progress).
error.deverrouillage_demande: This request is no longer pending (already decided, cancelled or expired).
error.deverrouillage_minutes: Invalid time: at most what was asked.
error.biometrie_parent: Biometrics can only be allowed on a device whose role has the “Fingerprint or face” function.
error.role_refuse: Refused: see the message at the top.
error.deverrouillage_deja_vote: You have already approved this request: another person needs to approve it.
error.ajout_pas_encore: Not paired yet. Finish the step on the device, then tap Next again.
error.ajout_expire: Time ran out: here is a new QR code (or a new command).
error.modules_dependances: Some modules that others need are missing (details above).
error.modules_confirmer: Tick the box to confirm, or close this window to keep the protections.
error.confirmer_restauration: Tick the box to confirm: the current configuration will be replaced.
error.sauvegarde_introuvable: This backup no longer exists. Choose another one.
error.sauvegarde_illisible: This backup cannot be read or comes from a newer version of Vision. Nothing was changed.
error.temps_gagne_minutes: Minutes per task go from 1 to 240, and the daily cap cannot be smaller than one task.
error.regles_lieu_trop: There are already 40 place rules: remove one before adding another.
error.accueil_modele_invalide: The Jinja template is not valid: check its syntax (details at the top of the screen).
error.soutien_vide: Paste the code you received by e-mail.
error.soutien_format: This is not a complete code: check that it was copied in full.
error.soutien_version: This code comes from a newer version of Vision: please update Vision.
error.soutien_signature: This code is not valid (signature rejected). Copy it again from the e-mail.
error.code_different: The two codes are not the same.

abort.not_loaded: Vision is not loaded: try again in a moment.
abort.entites_rien_a_piloter: No controllable entity is given to a person or device: choose some entities first (lights, switches, scripts, scenes, buttons, covers, thermostats).
abort.sauvegarde_faite: Backup done: {sauvegarde}. It is in the “{dossier}” folder of the Home Assistant configuration.
abort.sauvegarde_restauree: Configuration restored from the backup of {sauvegarde}. The previous state is kept: {avant}.
abort.aucune_sauvegarde: No backups yet. Start with “Back up now”.
abort.temps_gagne_coupe: The “Earned time” module (or “Screen time”) is turned off: turn it on in Configure → Modules.
abort.regles_lieu_coupe: The “Rules by place” module (or “App blocking” and “Web filtering”) is turned off: turn it on in Configure → Modules.
abort.essai_aucun_android: No Android device in Vision: nothing to set.
abort.soutien_merci: ♥ Thank you for your support! The badge appears on devices at their next check-in.

delete_tag.description: Removes the label from Home Assistant and from everything that had it, including rules and time slots that would no longer block anything.

set_pc_tag.description: On: everything with this label is blocked on this device. Off: the device says nothing about it — which is not the same as “allowed”.

set_house_tag.description: Bans or allows a label on all computers at once. “Back to sort” puts the decision back on the to-do pile — which is not the same as “allowed”.

etiquette.name: Label

set_pc_labels.description: Puts exactly these Home Assistant labels on the computer. These are the ones that group it with others (for example Living room, Bedrooms) for notifications — not the ones that sort sites and software.

decider_elements.description: Blocks, allows or puts back to sort one or more sites and software, for everyone. “Remove” only undoes an item added by hand: what a computer has seen will come back at the next check-in.

processus_lister.description: Returns the items seen on PCs (startup, scheduled tasks, services, processes) with publisher, signature, location and memory. For the sorter: call it asking for a response.

propositions.description: List of {cle, verdict (garder | hors_demarrage | nuisible), raison, confiance 0-100}.

par.description: Who is proposing (shown to the administrator who approves).

processus_decider.name: Decide
processus_decider.description: Decides for everyone. “Approve the proposal” takes the proposal, “Back to sort” puts it back to sort and has the agent restore it.

cles.name: Keys
cles.description: The item keys, as returned by “List processes”.

confirmation.name: Confirmation
confirmation.description: Required for “Uninstall”, which cannot be undone: one key at a time, and the “Uninstall by the agent” switch turned on.

fermer_categorie.name: Block a category
fermer_categorie.description: Blocks one or more categories for a person, on all their devices, saying why. Anything always allowed by name stays open. Call it from an automation.

categorie.name: Categories
categorie.description: The categories to block (Games, Videos, Social media…).

raison.name: Reason
raison.description: What the person will read on their screen (“Average 9.5 out of 20”).

source.name: Source
source.description: The name of what is blocking (“average”, “homework”). A category stays blocked as long as one source blocks it; “Unblock” with the same source only lifts that one. Empty: the default source.

ouvrir_categorie.name: Unblock a category
ouvrir_categorie.description: Unblocks categories blocked by an automation. With no category, unblocks all those from this source for this person.

categorie.name: Categories
categorie.description: The categories to unblock. Empty: all those this source blocked.

source.name: Source
source.description: The same source as when blocking. Blocks from other sources stay. Empty: the default source.

ajouter_temps.name: Add time
ajouter_temps.description: Opens a person's devices for a while, overriding the schedule. Time already granted and still running is extended. With no device given, applies to all of the person's devices, shared ones included.

personne.name: Person
personne.description: The person to give time to.

appareils.name: Devices
appareils.description: The devices to target, by their name in Home Assistant. Empty: all of the person's devices.

bilan_hebdo.name: Weekly summary
bilan_hebdo.description: Sends the summary of the last seven days right now (screen time, most used apps, requests), like the automatic send every Sunday at 7 pm.

remettre_a_zero.name: Start from zero
remettre_a_zero.description: Resets the week's counters (requests, access granted and declined, time added), like the Sunday send.

concentration.name: Focus
concentration.description: For a while (homework), only the chosen apps stay open on the person's devices. Vision, the phone, messages, the clock and the calculator always stay open. With no apps given, Vision reuses the last choice made for this person.

applis.name: Apps kept
applis.description: The names of the apps to keep open, as Vision knows them (“com.google.android.apps.docs”, “word”).

appareils.name: Devices
appareils.description: The names of the devices to target; empty for all of the person's devices.

arreter.name: Stop
arreter.description: Stops the current focus mode instead of starting one.

limiter_temps.name: Limit software time
limiter_temps.description: So many minutes per day for a piece of software or an app, on all of the person's devices. Once the time is used up, it is blocked until the next day. 0 removes the limit.

logiciel.name: Software
logiciel.description: The program name as Vision knows it (“roblox”, “com.supercell.brawlstars”).

partager_appareil.name: Share a device
partager_appareil.description: Says who else a device belongs to besides its main person. Sharing moves no rules; it says whose list the device appears in and who can get time on it. With no person and without “all devices”, the device is no longer shared.

code.name: Code
code.description: The short code shown on the device.

tag.description: Targets all devices with this Home Assistant label.

type.description: Worked out from the media if missing.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text, or the caption of a media item.

media.name: Media
media.description: A local Home Assistant media item (/media folder).

son.name: Sound
son.description: Sound Windows plays when the message arrives.

bloquant.name: Blocking
bloquant.description: No; until read = full screen until “I've read it”; until released = full screen until someone lifts it with the management code, or an administrator lifts it (pc_parental.liberer_message…).

limite.name: Safety limit
limite.description: Only for blocking until released; after this, it lifts by itself (logged).

expire.name: Expiry
expire.description: A message not delivered or not read expires after this.

liberer_message.name: Release a blocking message
liberer_message.description: Lifts a message blocking until released on a device (at the next check-in). Administrators only.

pc.name: Device
pc.description: Device name as shown in Home Assistant.

id.name: Message
id.description: Its number; with no number, all of the device's blocking messages.

approuver_deverrouillage.name: Approve an unlock
approuver_deverrouillage.description: Approves a device's unlock request (the action and time asked for, or less). Direct delivery (the device gets it by itself), by code (returned) or by QR code (returned). Administrators only.

remise.name: Delivery
remise.description: How the person gets the unlock.

refuser_deverrouillage.name: Decline an unlock
refuser_deverrouillage.description: Declines the unlock request. Administrators only.

nouvelle_cle_deverrouillage.name: New unlock key
nouvelle_cle_deverrouillage.description: Replaces the key that signs unlock approvals; those in progress no longer work. Devices get the new key at their next check-in. Administrators only.

pause_generale.name: Block everything
pause_generale.description: Blocks all supervised devices at once for a while; the devices of the people who decide stay open. “Allow again” allows them before the end. Administrators only.

fin_pause_generale.name: Allow again
fin_pause_generale.description: Allows again the devices that “Block everything” was holding: they go back to their schedule. A manual block from before is kept. Administrators only.

musique_vider_suite.name: Music — clear the queue
musique_vider_suite.description: Removes every track after the current one from the chosen speaker's Music Assistant queue (the current track keeps playing) and turns off automatic additions. Administrators only.

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: The Music Assistant player whose queue is cleared.

reveil_creer.name: Alarm — create
reveil_creer.description: Creates an alarm for a Requester. It is scheduled on their devices, which ring by themselves even if Home Assistant or the network is down. Returns the alarm id. Requires the « Alarm » module.

demandeur.name: Requester
demandeur.description: The person to wake up (person.*, or their name).

type.name: Trigger
type.description: hebdo (time + days), ponctuel (one date), entite (time read from a timestamp entity), modele (template rendering a date and time), manuel (only rings on command).

jours.name: Days
jours.description: For hebdo (0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday, or mon, tue…). Default Monday to Friday.

attribut.name: Attribute
attribut.description: Read this attribute instead of the state (optional).

modele.name: Template
modele.description: For modele; must render a date and time.

decalage.name: Offset
decalage.description: Minutes added to the time read (negative = earlier), for entite and modele.

bornes.name: Bounds
bornes.description: Range in which the computed time is accepted, [min, max] (default 05:00 – 10:00).

repli.name: Fallback time
repli.description: Used when the computed time is missing or out of bounds. Without a fallback, the occurrence is skipped and vision_reveil_echec is fired.

appareils.name: Devices
appareils.description: Vision devices of the Requester that ring (name or id). Default: their phones and tablets.

source.name: Source
source.description: sonnerie (ringtone), url (radio, podcast, stream), ma (Music Assistant), video. The local ringtone stays the fallback.

uri.name: Address or media
uri.description: http(s) address of the stream, or Music Assistant track / playlist / radio.

lecteur.name: Music Assistant player
lecteur.description: Speaker that plays the Music Assistant source (optional).

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: {debut: %, fin: %, montee_s: seconds} — default 10 → 60 % over 180 s.

impose.name: Imposed
impose.description: The Requester can neither change nor disable it (they can snooze and stop).

allumer_tv.name: Turn on the TV
allumer_tv.description: Use the power-on method chosen for the targeted TVs.

actif.name: Enabled
actif.description: A disabled alarm is armed on no device.

reveil_modifier.name: Alarm — modify
reveil_modifier.description: Modifies an alarm; only the given fields change. Same fields as « Alarm — create ».

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

demandeur.name: Requester
demandeur.description: Change the Requester (their devices do not follow).

reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

reveil_desactiver.name: Alarm — disable
reveil_desactiver.description: Disables an alarm; its devices disarm it at their next poll.

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

reveil_sauter.name: Alarm — skip an occurrence
reveil_sauter.description: Cancels a single occurrence (default: the next one) without changing the alarm. « Alarm — resume » undoes it.

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date to skip (default: the next occurrence).

reveil_reprendre.name: Alarm — resume an occurrence
reveil_reprendre.description: Undoes the skip of a date (default: the first skipped date).

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

reveil_sonner.name: Alarm — ring now
reveil_sonner.description: Rings right away, as soon as the devices poll (on a phone in deep sleep, without a guaranteed delay). Give an alarm, or a Requester.

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

demandeur.name: Requester
demandeur.description: Without an alarm, the person whose devices ring.

appareils.description: Default: the alarm's devices, or the Requester's phones and tablets.

lecteur.name: Music Assistant player
lecteur.description: Speaker that plays the Music Assistant source (optional).

reveil_reporter.name: Alarm — snooze
reveil_reporter.description: Snoozes the ringing alarm on all its devices.

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

reveil_arreter.name: Alarm — stop
reveil_arreter.description: Stops the ringing on all devices (one alarm, or all alarms of a Requester).

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

demandeur.name: Requester

reveil_supprimer.name: Alarm — delete
reveil_supprimer.description: Deletes an alarm, its entities and its Home Assistant device.

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

reveil_lister.name: Alarm — list
reveil_lister.description: Returns the visible alarms (next occurrence, state, synchronised devices) and the module settings.

reveil_regler.name: Alarm — module settings
reveil_regler.description: Place settings for the Alarm module. Administrators and automations only.

arret_auto_min.name: Auto stop
arret_auto_min.description: The device stops by itself after this delay (default 30 min).

fenetre_avant_min.name: Window before
fenetre_avant_min.description: binary_sensor.vision_fenetre_reveil turns on this long before the first occurrence (default 60 min).

fenetre_apres_min.name: Window after
fenetre_apres_min.description: And turns off this long after the last one (default 30 min).

synchro_avant_min.name: Sync check
synchro_avant_min.description: Delay before the time when an unsynchronised device is reported (default 10 min).

ordre_ttl_min.name: « Ring » order validity
ordre_ttl_min.description: An older « ring » order is no longer delivered (default 15 min).

horizon_h.name: Horizon
horizon_h.description: Hours of occurrences sent in advance to devices (default 48 h).

reveil_installer_modeles.name: Alarm — install the templates
reveil_installer_modeles.description: Places the blueprints shipped with the module (for example « Wake-up on school days ») in the Home Assistant blueprints folder (automations). An existing copy is never overwritten. Administrators only.
